events.title: LCID Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates on Inventory Write-Downs
events.body: LCID posts wider-than-expected Q1 loss and misses estimates as write-downs, costs and supplier issues hit margins, even as revenues grow and liquidity gets a boost.

events.title: TXU Energy EV charging program could work in other competitive markets: ChargeScape CEO
events.body: Ford electric vehicle drivers get 15 hours per day of “free” home charging under a special retail plan in Texas. The automaker says it shifted 515 MWh of energy to off-peak periods in 2025.

events.title: Ford CEO Jim Farley Says Industry Must Make EVs 'More Affordable' As New-Car Costs Strain Buyers

events.title: Cummins' Q1 Earnings Beat on Strong Power Systems Results
events.body: CMI beat Q1 2026 estimates as Power Systems and data-center power demand lifted margins, even as Engine and Components sales fell.
